name: Valour Cross
description: Awarded for the most conspicuous bravery, or some daring or pre-eminent act of valour or self-sacrifice, or extreme devotion to duty in the presence of the enemy. Gains you +10 points upon being awarded.

name: Distinguished Land Cross
description: Awarded for an act or acts of exemplary gallantry during active operations against the enemy on land. Gains you +5 points upon being awarded.

name: Distinguished Air Cross
description: Awarded for an act or acts of valour, courage or devotion to duty whilst flying in active operations against the enemy. Gains you +5 points upon being awarded.

name: Emergency Response Medal
description: Awarded for helping the faction out in times of need. Gains you +5 points upon being awarded.

name: Contributor Medal
description: Awarded for an act or acts of exemplary gallantry during active operations against the enemy on land. Gains you +5 points upon being awarded.

name: Booster Medal
description: Awarded for boosting the faction on discord. Also gains +10 points for every boost. Thank you!

name: Media Medal
description: Awarded at Head of Media Dept's discretion for good work relating to the Media Department. Gains you  +10 points upon being awarded.
